T16–T18 operational smoke fixtures, separate from all evaluation and holdout sets.

`apollo11.txt` and `apollo11.json` are concise factual paraphrases/structured transcriptions of [NASA's Apollo 11 overview](https://www.nasa.gov/mission/apollo-11/), checked 2026-10-15. The three named astronauts establish crew count 3. `apollo11.pdf` contains the same short factual paragraph, created once for format testing. It is not a NASA-designed PDF. No performance or broad quality claim follows from these small fixtures. Never regenerate fixtures as part of a test.

`exact.json` is explicitly synthetic and exercises exact decimals, zero and stored null. No real mission quantities are claimed.
